chunks.subject: AP Psychology
chunks.title: FRQ 1 Article Analysis Question (AAQ) — 7 points — Set 2
chunks.content: AP Psychology FRQ 1, Article Analysis Question (AAQ), 7 points, based on a source study (Set 2 uses a different study than Set 1). Scored by parts A–F. Same rules and task template as Set 1: identify the research method; identify an operational definition/population; describe the meaning of a statistical result; identify a control/design feature; apply psychological concepts to the study and explain how findings support or limit a conclusion. The concept must be applied to the study — a definition alone does not earn the point. Common failure: definition without application; misidentifying the research method; contradictory dual definitions.

chunks.title: AAQ Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1A, 7/7
chunks.content: AAQ (Set 2) scored 7/7 — identified the research method, applied each concept to the study, described the result accurately, and explained the findings. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Psychology
chunks.title: AAQ Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1B, 5/7
chunks.content: AAQ (Set 2) scored 5/7 — earned most parts but lost a couple where a concept was defined without being applied to the study or an explanation was incomplete. Illustrates a strong response short on full application.

chunks.subject: AP Psychology
chunks.title: AAQ Set 2 exemplar — Sample 1C, 2/7
chunks.content: AAQ (Set 2) scored 2/7 — earned only a couple of parts, losing most application/explanation points. Illustrates a response that engages the study only superficially.
